messages:
Elena (partnerships): Quick alert: we're scheduling a sunset for the legacy SDK compatibility layer (/v1/compat) on 2026-05-20. Need partner comms + migration playbook.
Noah (platform): Can do. Plan: announce 2026-04-05, offer a 6-week transparent proxy rewrite, provide tiny compatibility client and SDK patches.
Priya (integrations): I'll map affected partners: marketplace vendors, hardware OEMs, and two SIs. Please share exact request/response diffs so I can produce migration steps.
Tom (eng): Technical summary: old path relied on query flag `legacy=true` and altered streaming envelope. New API uses standard /v1/chat stream and a header `X-RW-Compat: legacy`. We'll keep behavior identical during rewrite window.
Elena (partnerships): Good. Offer two migration tracks: self-service patch (minor semver) and managed migration (marketplace shim + assisted rollout).
Noah (platform): Proposed safety: partner-only canaries, dashboard with per-partner error budgets, auto-fallback to compat layer if >8 errors/min. I'll own the dashboard.
Priya (integrations): I'll schedule invites for top 8 partners for canary slots. Also adding a rubric for which partners get managed migration.
Tom (eng): Snippet for partners:
```bash
# legacy
curl -H "X-Legacy: 1" https://api.redwood.com/v1/compat -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# new
curl -H "X-RW-Compat: legacy" https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
We'll publish quick patches for python/js.
VendorBot: Reminder: create Jira epic RW-PLT-599 for sunset, patches, and partner comms.
Elena (partnerships): I'll draft the email and a tracker. Next sync Thurs 2026-03-28 11:00 PT. Add any urgent partner flags to the sheet: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-PLT-599 :thumbsup:
Noah (platform): lgtm
Priya (integrations): noted
Tom (eng): lgtm
